summary: FINAL ACCEPTANCE — Track wire-kst-pipeline_20260521 PASSES. All five phases accepted with all functional requirements met. The KST pipeline is wired end-to-end: v2 mastery model (getKnowledgeState with hysteresis), standalone getOuterFringe with readinessFn seam for Track 2, SRS→KST bridge (DefaultSrsToKstBridge + buildKstState), IM3 production route at /student/knowledge-state consuming real 574-node/2708-edge graph. Full test suite: 901 tests across 60 test files (490 core + 373 practice + 38 IM3 KST pipeline). Boundary linter clean. Root tsc clean. Audit doc updated from placeholder to wired status.

FR2_knowledge_state_and_mastery.evidence: getKnowledgeState() implements time-aware hysteresis: enter mastered at retention >= 0.90 (masteryEnter), exit to decaying at < 0.70 (masteryExit), re-enter on recovery. Four-way state (mastered/decaying/inProgress/untouched). Configurable thresholds via MASTERY_THRESHOLDS_DEFAULT. Pure, deterministic function with now injected.

FR3_getOuterFringe.evidence: getOuterFringe() standalone top-level export (not buried in visualization projection). Binary prerequisite gating default. readinessFn seam for Track 2 weighted readiness.

FR4_srs_to_kst_bridge.evidence: DefaultSrsToKstBridge.convert() converts SRS card states + ObjectiveProficiencyResult[] to Map<NodeId, KnowledgeStateEntry>. buildKstState() convenience function. proficiency-to-card merging logic. Round-trip test covers bridge → getKnowledgeState → getOuterFringe.

FR5_production_wiring.evidence: One IM3 production route at /student/knowledge-state renders KST-derived student state. Convex internalQuery composes bridge + engine + fringe + projection. Batched Promise.all reads (2 calls regardless of card count). Authorization at server-component level via requireStudentSessionClaims.

FR6_graph_availability.evidence: loadFullCurriculumGraph() loads from curriculum/skill-graph/nodes.json + edges.json. 574 nodes / 2708 edges across all 9 IM3 modules. Used by production query. Graph-loader determinism verified (load twice, deep-equal).
